# kattle_cluster (Resource)

A kattle `Cluster`. Applying it waits until kattle has run the Airdrop `Stack` of the current spec. With the provider's `plan_preview`, `terraform plan` shows the Airdrop plan of each layer in `layer_plans`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kattle_cluster" "this" {
  metadata {
    namespace = "gsm-gameshard"
    name      = "gsm-dev-apne2-1"
    labels    = { team = "devops" }
  }

  # The stack module renders the Cluster with spec.layers.
  manifest = jsonencode(module.stack.manifest)

  timeouts {
    create = "2h"
    update = "2h"
    delete = "2h"
  }

  lifecycle {
    # A failed run or a wait timeout is a warning and keeps the Cluster in the state.
    # This postcondition fails the apply, and every later plan until a run of the current spec succeeds.
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.succeeded
      error_message = "kattle Cluster ${self.id} did not apply the current spec. See the warning above, fix the cause and run it again from kattle."
    }
  }
}

output "layer_plans" {
  value = kattle_cluster.this.layer_plans
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) JSON of the Cluster that the stack module renders, such as `jsonencode(module.stack.manifest)`. It has `spec` and may have `apiVersion` and `kind`, but not `metadata`.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Block List) Metadata of the Cluster. Exactly one block is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<namespace>/<name>`.
- `layer_plans` (Attributes List) Airdrop plan of each layer for the planned spec. Filled in only when the provider's `plan_preview` is on and the spec changes. `add`, `change` and `destroy` are null until Airdrop reports a plan summary for the layer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layer_plans))
- `stack_job` (String) Name of the last Airdrop StackJob that kattle reported for the Cluster.
- `succeeded` (Boolean) Whether kattle applied the current spec: `status.observedGeneration` equals `metadata.generation` and `StackSucceeded` is `True`. After the Cluster is written, a failed run or a wait timeout does not fail the apply. The provider sets this to `false` and reports a warning, so the resource is not tainted and the next apply does not replace the Cluster. Add `lifecycle { postcondition { condition = self.succeeded } }` to fail the apply, and every later plan until a run succeeds.
- `uid` (String) UID of the Cluster.

<a id="nestedblock--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name is the name of the resource. Changing it replaces the Cluster.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace is the namespace of the resource, the same as its Airdrop namespace. Changing it replaces the Cluster.

Optional:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. Annotations that others add are left alone and are not read back.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels are key value pairs that may be used to scope and select individual resources. The provider also sets `kattle.pubg.io/managed-by=terraform`. Labels that others add are left alone and are not read back.

Read-Only:

- `creation_timestamp` (String) CreationTimestamp is a timestamp representing the server time when this object was created.
- `resource_version` (String) ResourceVersion is an opaque value that changes on every update to a resource.
- `update_timestamp` (String) UpdateTimestamp is a timestamp representing the server time when this object was last updated.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--layer_plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layer_plans`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What Airdrop does to the layer's Crate: create, update or destroy.
- `add` (Number) Resources to add.
- `change` (Number) Resources to change.
- `destroy` (Number) Resources to destroy.
- `message` (String) Message that Airdrop reported for the layer.
- `name` (String) Name of the layer.
- `phase` (String) Phase of the layer in the plan run, such as Succeeded, Failed or Deferred.
- `plan_text` (String) Output of `terraform show -no-color` for the layer's plan, when Airdrop kept it.
- `reason` (String) Why the layer has its phase, such as PrecedingCrateMissing for a deferred layer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kattle_cluster.this gsm-gameshard/gsm-dev-apne2-1
```
